description: Two hooks implementing the generator/arbiter model economy. (1) SessionStart on startup/resume — injects a short reminder (session-start-economy.js) that the main agent — possibly on a premium tier above opus — should spend its tokens on judgment while bulk reading/exploration and bulk generation are delegated to subagents at haiku or opus; the reminder carries the absolute path to references/economy-playbook.md (passed as ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}) so the agent can read the full split on demand. Static context injection, writes nothing. (2) PreToolUse on the subagent-spawn tool (matcher Task|Agent) — economy-checkpoint.js inspects the spawn: when it targets a built-in bulk agent that inherits the session model (Explore / general-purpose, or an empty subagent_type which defaults to general-purpose), it rewrites tool_input via updatedInput — general-purpose/empty is ALWAYS redirected to subagent_type model-economy:worker, the plugin's opus-at-medium-effort executor, and Explore is ALWAYS redirected to subagent_type model-economy:explorer, the plugin's read-only haiku-at-xhigh-effort lookup agent; any pinned model is dropped (redirects because the spawn has no effort parameter) — and injects an additionalContext note saying what it did and, for Explore, to delegate as general-purpose instead if the search needs cross-file reasoning. Custom agents (own model frontmatter) are passed through untouched. It never denies and never sets permissionDecision, so it does not bypass the user's Task permission settings. Fail-open on any parse/shape error; reads stdin only, writes nothing.
